summary: GRI 416 covers customer health and safety, including an organization's systematic efforts to address health and safety across the life cycle of a product or service, and its adherence to customer health and safety regulations and voluntary codes.

questions.text: How does your organization manage the topic of customer health and safety, including its impacts, policies, actions and tracking of effectiveness?
questions.hint: Report how the organization manages this material topic using Disclosure 3-3 in GRI 3: Material Topics 2021.

questions.text: What percentage of your significant product and service categories are assessed for health and safety impacts for improvement?
questions.hint: a. Percentage of significant product and service categories for which health and safety impacts are assessed for improvement.

questions.text: How many incidents of non-compliance concerning the health and safety impacts of products and services occurred during the reporting period?
questions.hint: a. Total number of incidents of non-compliance with regulations and/or voluntary codes, by: i. regulations resulting in a fine or penalty; ii. regulations resulting in a warning; iii. voluntary codes. b. If none identified, a brief statement of this fact is sufficient.
